name: Egg and Avocado Toast
description: Whole-grain toast topped with creamy avocado, eggs, and fresh tomato.

instructions.title: Boil the eggs
instructions.instruction: Place the eggs in a small saucepan and cover them with cold water. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower the heat and simmer for 8 minutes.
instructions.safetyNote: Cook eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.

instructions.title: Mash the avocado
instructions.instruction: Put the avocado in a bowl. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then mash with a fork until mostly smooth.

instructions.title: Toast and cool the eggs
instructions.instruction: Toast the bread until crisp. Drain the hot water from the eggs, cool them under cold running water, peel them, and slice them.
instructions.safetyNote: Handle the hot saucepan carefully.

instructions.title: Assemble
instructions.instruction: Spread avocado over each toast slice. Add sliced egg and tomatoes, then finish with black pepper.

name: Oatmeal with Berries
description: Warm cinnamon oats with mixed berries, chia seeds, and a touch of yogurt.

instructions.title: Heat the milk
instructions.instruction: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and heat it over medium heat until small bubbles appear around the edge. Do not let it boil over.

instructions.title: Cook the oats
instructions.instruction: Stir in the oats and cinnamon. Lower the heat to medium-low and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.

instructions.title: Add berries
instructions.instruction: Stir half of the berries into the oats for the final minute. Frozen berries should be hot all the way through.

instructions.title: Finish the bowl
instructions.instruction: Pour the oats into a bowl. Top with yogurt, chia seeds, and the remaining berries. Let it cool for 1 minute before eating.
instructions.safetyNote: Hot oatmeal can hold heat; test a small spoonful first.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
description: Protein-rich Greek yogurt with berries, banana, oats, and crunchy seeds.

instructions.title: Prepare the fruit
instructions.instruction: Rinse the berries under cool water and pat them dry. Peel and slice the banana into bite-sized rounds.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a stable cutting board when slicing.

instructions.title: Add the yogurt
instructions.instruction: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a wide bowl and spread it into an even layer.

instructions.title: Arrange the toppings
instructions.instruction: Place the berries, banana, oats, and pumpkin seeds in separate rows over the yogurt.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.instruction: Drizzle with honey if desired and serve immediately so the oats and seeds stay crisp.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep yogurt refrigerated until ready to use.

name: Protein Pancakes
description: Soft banana-oat pancakes made with eggs and cottage cheese for extra protein.

instructions.title: Blend the batter
instructions.instruction: Add oats, cottage cheese, eggs, banana, and baking powder to a blender. Blend for 30 to 45 seconds until mostly smooth.
instructions.safetyNote: Make sure the blender lid is secure before starting.

instructions.title: Heat the pan
instructions.instruction: Place a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the oil and spread it over the surface. The pan is ready when a drop of water gently sizzles.

instructions.title: Cook the first side
instructions.instruction: Pour about 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form and the edges look set.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep the heat medium-low so the outside does not burn before the egg cooks.

instructions.title: Flip and serve
instructions.instruction: Slide a spatula under each pancake, flip, and cook for 1 to 2 more minutes. Serve when both sides are golden and the center is firm.
instructions.safetyNote: Egg-based batter should be cooked through, not wet in the center.

name: Egg and Vegetable Omelette
description: A colorful omelette filled with spinach, bell pepper, mushrooms, and feta.

instructions.title: Whisk the eggs
instructions.instruction: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper, and whisk with a fork until the yolks and whites are fully combined.
instructions.safetyNote: Wash your hands after touching raw egg shells.

instructions.title: Cook the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add pepper and mushrooms and cook for 4 minutes, then add spinach and stir until wilted.

instructions.title: Add the eggs
instructions.instruction: Spread the vegetables evenly and pour in the eggs. Reduce the heat to medium-low. Gently lift the cooked edges so uncooked egg can flow underneath.

instructions.title: Fold and finish
instructions.instruction: When the top is nearly set, add feta to one half. Fold the other half over and cook for 1 more minute before sliding onto a plate.
instructions.safetyNote: The eggs should be fully set with no runny areas.

name: High-Protein Overnight Oats
description: Creamy make-ahead oats with Greek yogurt, chia seeds, and berries.

instructions.title: Combine the base
instructions.instruction: Add oats, yogurt, milk, chia seeds, and maple syrup to a clean jar. Stir until no dry oats remain at the bottom.

instructions.title: Add the fruit
instructions.instruction: Gently fold in half of the berries and place the remaining berries on top.

instructions.title: Chill overnight
instructions.instruction: Close the jar and refrigerate for at least 6 hours. The oats and chia seeds will absorb the liquid and soften.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep the jar refrigerated at 40 F / 4 C or colder.

instructions.title: Check and serve
instructions.instruction: Stir before eating. If the oats are too thick, add 1 or 2 tablespoons of milk until they reach the texture you prefer.
instructions.safetyNote: Eat refrigerated overnight oats within 3 days.

name: Chicken and Rice Bowl
description: Seasoned chicken breast, brown rice, broccoli, and peppers in a balanced bowl.

instructions.title: Cook the rice
instructions.instruction: Rinse the rice under cold water. Put it in a saucepan with water according to the package directions. Bring to a boil, cover, lower the heat, and simmer until tender.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep the saucepan handle turned away from the edge of the stove.

instructions.title: Prepare the chicken
instructions.instruction: Pat the chicken dry and cut it into evenly sized pieces on a separate cutting board. Toss it with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
instructions.safetyNote: Wash hands, knife, and board after handling raw chicken.

instructions.title: Cook chicken and vegetables
instructions.instruction: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, turning often. Add broccoli and pepper with 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and cook 4 minutes.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C at its thickest point.

instructions.title: Build the bowl
instructions.instruction: Fluff the cooked rice with a fork. Add rice to a bowl, then arrange the chicken and vegetables on top. Taste before adding extra salt.

name: Quinoa Chicken Bowl
description: Herbed chicken with quinoa, cucumber, tomato, spinach, and lemon yogurt.

instructions.title: Cook the quinoa
instructions.instruction: Rinse quinoa in a fine strainer. Add it to a saucepan with 1 cup water, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for about 15 minutes. Rest covered for 5 minutes.

instructions.title: Season the chicken
instructions.instruction: Pat chicken dry and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep raw chicken separate from vegetables that will be eaten uncooked.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.instruction: Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked, then rest it for 3 minutes.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C internally.

instructions.title: Assemble
instructions.instruction: Fluff quinoa and add it to a bowl with spinach, cucumber, and tomato. Slice the rested chicken, place it on top, and spoon over the lemon yogurt.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: Juicy chicken over crisp greens with vegetables, avocado, and lemon dressing.

instructions.title: Prepare the salad
instructions.instruction: Wash and dry the greens and vegetables. Slice the cucumber, tomatoes, and avocado, then place everything except the avocado in a large bowl.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a clean board for vegetables.

instructions.title: Season the chicken
instructions.instruction: Pat chicken dry, brush it lightly with oil, and season both sides with salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.safetyNote: Wash your hands and tools after handling raw chicken.

instructions.title: Cook and rest
instructions.instruction: Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, then rest it on a clean plate for 3 minutes before slicing.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C internally.

instructions.title: Dress and serve
instructions.instruction: Toss the greens and vegetables with the lemon dressing. Add avocado and sliced chicken on top, then serve immediately.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
description: A filling bowl with spiced chicken, rice, black beans, corn, and fresh salsa.

instructions.title: Warm the base
instructions.instruction: Cook rice according to its package if needed. Warm the beans and corn in a small saucepan over medium-low heat with 2 tablespoons of water.

instructions.title: Season the chicken
instructions.instruction: Pat chicken dry and toss it with cumin, chili powder, a pinch of salt, and 1 teaspoon oil.
instructions.safetyNote: Clean surfaces that touch raw chicken.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.instruction: Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the diced chicken for 7 to 9 minutes, stirring every 1 to 2 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C internally.

instructions.title: Build the bowl
instructions.instruction: Add rice to the bowl, followed by beans, corn, chicken, and salsa. Keep each ingredient in a section or mix them together before eating.

name: Paneer Rice Bowl
description: Golden paneer, brown rice, peas, peppers, and spinach with warm Indian spices.

instructions.title: Prepare the ingredients
instructions.instruction: Cut paneer into equal cubes and slice the pepper. Measure the peas, spinach, rice, and spices before heating the pan.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a stable cutting board.

instructions.title: Brown the paneer
instructions.instruction: Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat with 1 teaspoon oil. Add paneer in one layer and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, turning until several sides are golden.
instructions.safetyNote: Turn paneer gently to avoid hot oil splashes.

instructions.title: Cook the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Add pepper, peas, garam masala, and 2 tablespoons of water. Cook for 4 minutes, then stir in spinach until wilted.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.instruction: Warm the rice, place it in a bowl, and spoon the paneer and vegetables over it. Taste and add salt only if needed.
instructions.safetyNote: Reheated rice should be steaming hot throughout.

name: Tofu Vegetable Bowl
description: Crisp tofu with brown rice, edamame, broccoli, carrots, and sesame sauce.

instructions.title: Dry the tofu
instructions.instruction: Wrap tofu in paper towels and press it gently under a plate for 5 minutes. Cut it into even cubes so the pieces cook at the same rate.

instructions.title: Crisp the tofu
instructions.instruction: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add tofu in one layer and cook for 8 minutes, turning every 2 minutes until golden.
instructions.safetyNote: Add tofu carefully because remaining moisture may cause light splattering.

instructions.title: Cook the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Add broccoli, carrot, edamame, and 3 tablespoons of water. Cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until bright and tender-crisp.

instructions.title: Sauce and serve
instructions.instruction: Pour in the sauce and stir for 1 minute. Serve the tofu and vegetables over hot brown rice.

name: Berry Protein Shake
description: A cold berry smoothie with Greek yogurt, milk, oats, and chia seeds.

instructions.title: Add liquids first
instructions.instruction: Pour the milk and yogurt into the blender first. This helps the blades move freely.

instructions.title: Add remaining ingredients
instructions.instruction: Add berries, oats, and chia seeds. Secure the blender lid firmly.
instructions.safetyNote: Never place utensils inside a blender while it is running.

instructions.title: Blend
instructions.instruction: Blend on low for 15 seconds, then high for 30 to 45 seconds until smooth. Stop and scrape the sides only after the blades stop.

instructions.title: Adjust and serve
instructions.instruction: Add a splash of milk if the shake is too thick, blend briefly again, and serve immediately.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep dairy ingredients refrigerated until use.

name: Banana Protein Shake
description: Banana, peanut butter, milk, and Greek yogurt blended into a filling snack.

instructions.title: Load the blender
instructions.instruction: Add milk and yogurt first, followed by banana, peanut butter, and cinnamon.

instructions.title: Secure the lid
instructions.instruction: Place the lid firmly on the blender and hold it in place before switching the machine on.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not operate the blender without its lid.

instructions.title: Blend until smooth
instructions.instruction: Blend on low for 15 seconds and then high for about 30 seconds. The shake should have no visible banana pieces.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.instruction: Pour into a glass. If needed, blend in 1 or 2 tablespoons of milk to make it thinner.
instructions.safetyNote: Serve promptly or refrigerate and drink within 24 hours.

name: Apple Peanut Butter Yogurt
description: Crisp apple with Greek yogurt, peanut butter, cinnamon, and walnuts.

instructions.title: Prepare the apple
instructions.instruction: Rinse and dry the apple. Cut it into quarters, remove the core, and dice it into small bite-sized pieces.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep fingertips curled away from the knife blade.

instructions.title: Fill the bowl
instructions.instruction: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl and stir in the cinnamon.

instructions.title: Add toppings
instructions.instruction: Add the diced apple and chopped walnuts. Warm the peanut butter for 10 seconds only if needed to make it easier to drizzle.
instructions.safetyNote: Confirm the container is microwave safe before warming peanut butter.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.instruction: Drizzle peanut butter over the bowl and serve immediately for the best texture.
instructions.safetyNote: Contains peanuts and tree nuts.

name: Cottage Cheese Fruit Bowl
description: Creamy cottage cheese with pineapple, berries, and sunflower seeds.

instructions.title: Prepare the fruit
instructions.instruction: Drain the pineapple if needed. Rinse, dry, remove the tops from the strawberries, and slice them.

instructions.title: Add cottage cheese
instructions.instruction: Spoon the cottage cheese into a serving bowl and smooth the top.

instructions.title: Top the bowl
instructions.instruction: Arrange pineapple and strawberries over the cottage cheese, then sprinkle with sunflower seeds and cinnamon.

instructions.title: Serve cold
instructions.instruction: Eat immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to one day.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep cottage cheese refrigerated at 40 F / 4 C or colder.

name: Hummus Vegetable Wrap
description: A whole-grain wrap filled with hummus, crunchy vegetables, spinach, and feta.

instructions.title: Prepare the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Rinse and dry the cucumber, pepper, and spinach. Cut the cucumber and pepper into thin strips that will fit easily inside the wrap.

instructions.title: Spread the hummus
instructions.instruction: Lay the tortilla flat and spread hummus over it, leaving a 2 cm border around the edge.

instructions.title: Fill the wrap
instructions.instruction: Place spinach, cucumber, pepper, and feta in a line across the center. Avoid overfilling so the tortilla can close.

instructions.title: Roll and slice
instructions.instruction: Fold the left and right sides inward, then roll tightly from the bottom. Place seam-side down and cut in half.
instructions.safetyNote: Use a clean, stable board when slicing.

name: Roasted Chickpea Snack
description: Crisp oven-roasted chickpeas seasoned with paprika, cumin, and garlic.

instructions.title: Heat the oven
instructions.instruction: Set the oven to 400 F / 200 C. Place an empty baking sheet nearby while the oven heats.

instructions.title: Dry the chickpeas
instructions.instruction: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Spread them on a clean towel and pat very dry; removing moisture helps them become crisp.

instructions.title: Season and roast
instructions.instruction: Toss chickpeas with oil and spices, spread them in one layer, and roast for 25 to 30 minutes. Shake the tray carefully halfway through.
instructions.safetyNote: Use oven mitts whenever moving the hot baking sheet.

instructions.title: Cool
instructions.instruction: Let the chickpeas cool on the tray for 10 minutes. They become crisper as they cool.
instructions.safetyNote: Chickpeas are very hot inside immediately after roasting.

name: Salmon and Rice Bowl
description: Oven-baked salmon with brown rice, edamame, cucumber, and sesame.

instructions.title: Heat the oven
instructions.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 F / 200 C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Season the salmon
instructions.instruction: Pat salmon dry and place it on the tray. Brush with half the soy sauce and season lightly with pepper.
instructions.safetyNote: Wash hands and tools after touching raw fish.

instructions.title: Bake and warm
instructions.instruction: Bake salmon for 12 to 15 minutes. Meanwhile, warm the rice and edamame until steaming hot.
instructions.safetyNote: Fish should reach 145 F / 63 C and flake easily with a fork.

instructions.title: Build the bowl
instructions.instruction: Add rice, edamame, and cucumber to a bowl. Place salmon on top, drizzle with remaining soy sauce, and add sesame seeds.
instructions.safetyNote: Check carefully for small fish bones before eating.

name: Turkey Rice Bowl
description: Lean ground turkey with rice, green beans, carrots, and a ginger soy sauce.

instructions.title: Prepare the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Trim and halve the green beans and thinly slice the carrot. Mix soy sauce, ginger, and 2 tablespoons of water in a small cup.

instructions.title: Brown the turkey
instructions.instruction: Heat a large pan over medium-high heat. Add turkey and cook for 7 to 9 minutes, breaking it into small pieces with a wooden spoon.
instructions.safetyNote: Ground turkey must reach 165 F / 74 C with no pink remaining.

instructions.title: Cook the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Add green beans and carrot. Pour in the sauce, cover, and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until the vegetables are tender-crisp.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.instruction: Place hot rice in a bowl and spoon the turkey and vegetables over it, including the sauce from the pan.
instructions.safetyNote: Reheated rice should be steaming hot.

name: Chicken Tortillas
description: Whole-grain tortillas filled with seasoned chicken, peppers, lettuce, and yogurt sauce.

instructions.title: Prepare the fillings
instructions.instruction: Slice the pepper and onion. On a separate board, cut chicken into thin, even strips and season with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
instructions.safetyNote: Keep raw chicken and salad vegetables on separate boards or clean thoroughly between them.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.instruction: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, then transfer it to a clean plate.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C internally.

instructions.title: Cook peppers and warm tortillas
instructions.instruction: Add pepper and onion to the same pan and cook for 4 minutes. Warm tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds per side.

instructions.title: Fill and fold
instructions.instruction: Divide lettuce, vegetables, chicken, and yogurt sauce between tortillas. Fold in the sides, roll from the bottom, and serve.

name: Lentil Rice Bowl
description: Comforting lentils and brown rice with tomato, spinach, and warming spices.

instructions.title: Start the sauce
instructions.instruction: Place a saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 teaspoon oil and the spices, then stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not lean directly over the pan when spices heat.

instructions.title: Simmer the lentils
instructions.instruction: Add tomatoes, broth, and lentils. Bring to a gentle simmer, lower the heat, and cook uncovered for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

instructions.title: Add spinach
instructions.instruction: Stir in spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. If the mixture becomes too thick, add 1 tablespoon of water.

instructions.title: Serve over rice
instructions.instruction: Warm the brown rice until steaming, place it in a bowl, and spoon the lentil mixture over the top.
instructions.safetyNote: Reheated rice and lentils should be steaming hot throughout.

name: Healthy Tuna Pasta
description: Whole-wheat pasta with tuna, tomatoes, spinach, peas, and lemon.

instructions.title: Cook the pasta
instructions.instruction: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil. Add pasta and cook according to the package until tender but still slightly firm. Save 1/4 cup cooking water, then drain.
instructions.safetyNote: Drain boiling water carefully and keep steam away from your face.

instructions.title: Cook the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add tomatoes and peas and cook for 4 minutes until the tomatoes begin to soften.

instructions.title: Combine
instructions.instruction: Add pasta, spinach, drained tuna, lemon juice, and 2 tablespoons of reserved pasta water. Stir gently for 2 minutes until spinach wilts and tuna is hot.
instructions.safetyNote: Check tuna carefully for any small bones.

instructions.title: Season and serve
instructions.instruction: Taste and add black pepper. Add another spoonful of pasta water if the pasta looks dry, then serve hot.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Stir Fry
description: Quick chicken stir fry with broccoli, snap peas, peppers, and brown rice.

instructions.title: Prepare everything first
instructions.instruction: Cut all vegetables before cooking. On a separate board, slice chicken into thin, even strips and pat them dry.
instructions.safetyNote: Clean the knife, board, and hands after handling raw chicken.

instructions.title: Cook the chicken
instructions.instruction: Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken in one layer and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, then move it to a clean plate.
instructions.safetyNote: Chicken must reach 165 F / 74 C internally.

instructions.title: Stir-fry the vegetables
instructions.instruction: Add broccoli, snap peas, pepper, and 2 tablespoons of water to the hot pan. Stir frequently for 4 to 5 minutes until bright and tender-crisp.

instructions.title: Combine and serve
instructions.instruction: Return chicken to the pan, add sauce, and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until everything is hot and coated. Serve over brown rice.
